chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Muqarin (one who performs Hajj al-Qiran) does not have [his status] except with the accompanying sacrificial animal, and upon him is circumambulation of the House, and two cycles of prayer at the Standing Place of Ibrahim (peace be upon him), and Sa'ee between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, and circumambulation after Hajj, and it is the circumambulation of the women.

key_terms.الْقَارِنُ: Muqarin: A pilgrim who performs Hajj al-Qiran, combining Umrah and Hajj.
key_terms.سَعْيٌ: Sa'ee: Ritual walking between Safa and Marwa.
key_terms.طَوَافٌ: Tawaf: Ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba.
key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaf al-Nisa: The final circumambulation performed after Hajj.
key_terms.مَقَامُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: The Standing Place of Ibrahim, located near the Kaaba.

ai.seo_question: What are the ritual obligations for a Muqarin in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In the Shia scholarly tradition, this hadith clarifies that the Muqarin (one who combines Umrah and Hajj) must perform the rituals in a specific sequence, integrating the sacrificial animal (Hady) with the standard rites of Tawaf, Salat, Sa'ee, and the concluding Tawaf al-Nisa. This ruling emphasizes the structural integrity of the combined pilgrimage, distinguishing it from the separate performance of Umrah and Hajj, and underscores the necessity of the Hady as a binding condition for this specific mode of worship.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The performance of the pairing (Hajj) does not happen except with ushering of the sacrificial animal, and upon him is the circumambulation of the House (Kabah), and two Cycles by the Standing Place of Ibrahim<sup>as</sup>, and one Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, and one circumambulation after the Hajj, and it is the circumambulation (for) the women (طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

One who performs al-Qiran al-Hajj is required to drive the offering animal, he must perform Tawaf around the House, two Rak‘at Salat (prayer) near Maqam of Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al-Salam, Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah, and one Tawaf after al-Hajj, which is Tawaf of women.’”
